svg.title: HARTH sampling sensitivity and nested training-data scaling
svg.desc: Workflow for HARTH v2.0 sampling and nested training-size analysis. The full eligible Development cohort has 132397 windows from 29 participants. Independent cap 250, 500 and 1000 policies measure activity retention and independent contributor support; at cap 500 Shuffling retains 219 of 1946 windows from 26 of 28 original contributors. A separate strictly nested Train expansion from 10000 to 20000 windows compares Random Forest and weighted CNN on the same 2701 Validation windows, reporting final Macro F1 from executed stage 06 evidence. Illustrative wearable signals are schematic, not measured samples.

g.text: HARTH SAMPLING SENSITIVITY AND NESTED TRAINING SCALE
HARTH v2.0 · 29 Development participants · 132,397 eligible windows · Fixed-Validation comparison
2,701 fixed Validation windows · RF increases at 1,000 Train · Weighted CNN final-epoch score declines
